nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.description: Backend-as-a-service used for auth, cloud sync, and the meal_entries table.

nodes.label: supabase-setup.sql
nodes.description: SQL script executed against the Supabase project to provision required schema.

nodes.label: vercel.json
nodes.description: Vercel configuration file holding COOP header and CSP connect-src rules.

nodes.label: syncService
nodes.description: Module responsible for flushing the local syncQueue to Supabase, using onConflict: 'id' to avoid duplicate entries.

nodes.label: syncQueue (IndexedDB)
nodes.description: IndexedDB table tracking pending local writes to be synced to Supabase.

nodes.label: review-loop SKILL.md
nodes.description: Project skill defining how to triage manual review feedback after an automated verify pass, distinguishing mechanical fixes from spec gaps.

nodes.label: sdd-verify (automated verify)
nodes.description: Automated verification step that checks work against a spec; review-loop triggers after this passes but a human still finds issues.

nodes.label: Mechanical fix
nodes.description: Feedback category where the spec was correct but the implementation missed it (e.g. wrong color, spacing, copy).

nodes.label: Spec gap
nodes.description: Feedback category where the built behavior matches the spec, but the spec itself was wrong or incomplete.

nodes.label: Spike: COOP same-origin + Supabase Redirect OAuth
nodes.description: Investigation confirming Supabase redirect-based OAuth is compatible with Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin headers required for OPFS.
nodes.norm_label: spike: coop same-origin + supabase redirect oauth

nodes.label: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin
nodes.description: HTTP header required (along with COEP: credentialless) for crossOriginIsolated / OPFS support.

nodes.label: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: credentialless
nodes.description: HTTP header used alongside COOP to enable crossOriginIsolated for OPFS.

nodes.label: OPFS (Origin Private File System)
nodes.description: Browser storage API requiring crossOriginIsolated, enabled by COOP/COEP headers; planned storage layer for Vitia.

nodes.label: Supabase redirect-based OAuth
nodes.description: Full-page redirect OAuth flow (signInWithOAuth with skipBrowserRedirect: false) confirmed compatible with COOP same-origin.

nodes.label: Open Food Facts API
nodes.description: External food data API already allowed in vercel.json connect-src (world.openfoodfacts.org); planned food data source for Vitia.

nodes.description: HTML entry point mounting the React app via /src/main.tsx and referencing the PWA manifest.

nodes.label: manifest.webmanifest

nodes.label: src/main.tsx
nodes.description: React entry point script loaded as a module by index.html.
